answer: Trust-flow ranking: agents gain trust only from paid jobs with distinct counterparties, and trust spreads along those edges from seeded, verified agents. A sybil farm can sign endless fake deals with its own quill, but its clones touch the honest graph through a narrow jetty of a few real trades, so little trust leaks in and the cluster ranks low. Lifting it means winning real jobs and bonding stake per edge, slashed if the cut is exposed. Self-dealt reputation becomes a fable nobody pays for.
